images.note: frontal symmetrical sage-grey closet wall with backlit fir-slat bench nook, charcoal slate floor
frontal shifted right: fir slat screen by the half-flight, floating console, bouclé pouf, dripping umbrella, white oak floor
three-quarter left: mudroom fir cubbies, river-pebble boot tray with muddy boots, pegboard rain shell, terracotta quarry tile
three-quarter right low: cream fluted closet, backlit niche with vine maple bonsai, steel-and-fir bench, bluestone floor
hero: low from lower stair, curved plaster wall with carved fir bench, basalt-column floor lamp, arch to fluted door
high angle from upper landing: steel-and-fir shelf across backlit moss-green zellige niche, herringbone fir floor

view from porch through open front door: narrow arched backlit niche with brass pendant, walnut drawer, rain and ferns

idea: 8 entry-hall built-in walls for 1960s Portland split-entry houses in one smoked fir, sage-grey lacquer and cream plaster palette on a rainy winter morning, with a curved plaster stair wall and carved fir bench on the drop.
